data.long_meaning: The name Ghosh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ghoshana’, meaning royal announcement. It is a name of ancient origin and holds deep significance in Hindu culture. The name is believed to bring good fortune and is often given to children as a symbol of royal lineage and power. The name Ghosh carries the meaning “Royal Announcement” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ghosh usually hope their child will grow to embody royal announcement and live with faith, good character and purpose.
